🎮 DOMINATE THE BATTLEFIELD 🎮

Stop playing with lag. Start playing to win.
Unlock Ultra Extreme 120 FPS and Extreme HDR graphics in PUBG Mobile, BGMI and more,
by making your phone identify itself as a Redmagic 10 Pro.

PUBG Mobile with the module installed: Extreme HDR graphics and Ultra Extreme (120 FPS) frame rate unlocked.
--- ## 🚀 Features * ✅ **Unlocks 90 / 120 FPS** (Ultra Extreme frame rate, where the game supports it) * ✅ **Unlocks HDR / Extreme HDR graphics** * ✅ **Redmagic 10 Pro device spoofing** (model `NX789J`) * ✅ **Universal support** (PUBG, BGMI, CODM, Free Fire) * ✅ **Tiny and clean**: changes only the phone's model name, nothing else * ✅ **No thermal or kernel tweaks**: your phone's normal heat and battery protection stays in place --- ## 📦 Requirements * A **rooted** Android phone * **Magisk v20.4 or newer**, or **KernelSU** (APatch should also work, but it is not tested yet) * A screen that supports **90 Hz or 120 Hz**, if you want to actually see 90 / 120 FPS --- ## 🛠️ Installation ### Magisk 1. Download the latest zip from the **[Releases page](https://github.com/shakilxt/ULTRA-EXTREME-UNLOCKER/releases/latest)**. 2. Open the **Magisk** app and go to **Modules**. 3. Tap **Install from storage** and select the downloaded zip. 4. Wait for the installation to finish, then **reboot**. ### KernelSU 1. Download the latest zip from the **[Releases page](https://github.com/shakilxt/ULTRA-EXTREME-UNLOCKER/releases/latest)**. 2. Open the **KernelSU** app and go to **Modules**. 3. Tap **Install** and select the downloaded zip. 4. Wait for the installation to finish, then **reboot**. After restarting, launch your game and check the available graphics and FPS options. ### Uninstall Open Magisk or KernelSU → **Modules** → remove **ULTRA EXTREME UNLOCKER** → **reboot**. Your phone goes back to its real model name. --- ## ❓ Troubleshooting & FAQ
The new FPS or graphics options are not showing
1. Make sure the module is **enabled** in Magisk / KernelSU and that you **rebooted** after installing. 2. Force stop the game and open it again. 3. If the options are still missing, clear the game's **cache** (Settings → Apps → the game → Storage → Clear cache). Do not clear **data** unless you are ready to download the game files again. 4. Games sometimes change their settings after an update. If it stopped working after a game update, please [open an issue](https://github.com/shakilxt/ULTRA-EXTREME-UNLOCKER/issues) with the game name and version.
"Invalid module ID in module.prop" error when installing
This was a bug in v0.0.2 and earlier. Download **v0.0.3 or newer** from the [Releases page](https://github.com/shakilxt/ULTRA-EXTREME-UNLOCKER/releases/latest).
The game shows 120 FPS but it doesn't feel smoother
Your screen's refresh rate must be set to **120 Hz** (or 90 Hz for 90 FPS). Check Settings → Display → Refresh rate on your phone.
My phone gets hot or the battery drains faster
Higher FPS and graphics make the GPU work harder, so more heat and battery use is expected. Choose a lower graphics or frame rate setting in the game if it gets too hot.
Can I get banned for using this?
The module only changes the model name and does not touch the game itself. Still, using root or a modified phone is always at your own risk. Please read the disclaimer below.

The developer (**shakilxt**) is not responsible for any device damage, account bans, data loss, warranty issues, or other consequences resulting from the use of this module.

🎮 DOMINATE THE BATTLEFIELD 🎮

Stop playing with lag. Start playing to win.

Unlock Ultra Extreme 120 FPS and Extreme HDR graphics in PUBG Mobile, BGMI and more,

by making your phone identify itself as a Redmagic 10 Pro.

PUBG Mobile with the module installed: Extreme HDR graphics and Ultra Extreme (120 FPS) frame rate unlocked.

---

🚀 Features

  • ✅ **Unlocks 90 / 120 FPS** (Ultra Extreme frame rate, where the game supports it)
  • ✅ **Unlocks HDR / Extreme HDR graphics**
  • ✅ **Redmagic 10 Pro device spoofing** (model `NX789J`)
  • ✅ **Universal support** (PUBG, BGMI, CODM, Free Fire)
  • ✅ **Tiny and clean**: changes only the phone's model name, nothing else
  • ✅ **No thermal or kernel tweaks**: your phone's normal heat and battery protection stays in place

    • ---

    📦 Requirements

  • A **rooted** Android phone
  • **Magisk v20.4 or newer**, or **KernelSU** (APatch should also work, but it is not tested yet)
  • A screen that supports **90 Hz or 120 Hz**, if you want to actually see 90 / 120 FPS

    • ---

    🛠️ Installation

    Magisk

  • Download the latest zip from the **[Releases page](https://github.com/shakilxt/ULTRA-EXTREME-UNLOCKER/releases/latest)**.
  • Open the **Magisk** app and go to **Modules**.
  • Tap **Install from storage** and select the downloaded zip.
  • Wait for the installation to finish, then **reboot**.

    • KernelSU

  • Download the latest zip from the **[Releases page](https://github.com/shakilxt/ULTRA-EXTREME-UNLOCKER/releases/latest)**.
  • Open the **KernelSU** app and go to **Modules**.
  • Tap **Install** and select the downloaded zip.
  • Wait for the installation to finish, then **reboot**.

    • After restarting, launch your game and check the available graphics and FPS options.

    Uninstall

    Open Magisk or KernelSU → Modules → remove ULTRA EXTREME UNLOCKER → reboot. Your phone goes back to its real model name.

    ---

    ❓ Troubleshooting & FAQ

    The new FPS or graphics options are not showing


  • Make sure the module is **enabled** in Magisk / KernelSU and that you **rebooted** after installing.
  • Force stop the game and open it again.
  • If the options are still missing, clear the game's **cache** (Settings → Apps → the game → Storage → Clear cache). Do not clear **data** unless you are ready to download the game files again.
  • Games sometimes change their settings after an update. If it stopped working after a game update, please [open an issue](https://github.com/shakilxt/ULTRA-EXTREME-UNLOCKER/issues) with the game name and version.

    • "Invalid module ID in module.prop" error when installing


    This was a bug in v0.0.2 and earlier. Download v0.0.3 or newer from the Releases page.

    The game shows 120 FPS but it doesn't feel smoother


    Your screen's refresh rate must be set to 120 Hz (or 90 Hz for 90 FPS). Check Settings → Display → Refresh rate on your phone.

    My phone gets hot or the battery drains faster


    Higher FPS and graphics make the GPU work harder, so more heat and battery use is expected. Choose a lower graphics or frame rate setting in the game if it gets too hot.

    Can I get banned for using this?


    The module only changes the model name and does not touch the game itself. Still, using root or a modified phone is always at your own risk. Please read the disclaimer below.
